checks.name: independent graph reachability oracle
checks.result: 60 seeded random directed graphs with recursion, duplicate edges, captured and uncaptured internal functions and all three extern contract states compared against independent Python per-root reachable-set classification. Plus8192-node chains ending in pure/Unknown/may-block and exact65536 repeated-edge positive boundary. All64 graphs,479 required-root outcomes match.

checks.name: stable summaries, finite queue and read-only isolation
checks.result: Direct analyzer harness overwrites the shared instruction arena per caller; stable DeclIds still propagate correctly. It compares every injected Inst field/span immediately after capture and declaration identity/content after finish. Deliberate capture-time Inst.bits mutation is caught with exit90 despite unchanged call graph. Source audit finds no semantic table writes. Each initial seed consumes at least one of two bits; subsequent enqueue requires a new bit, bounding enqueue count by2V. Reverse adjacency only stores stable caller DeclId/next edge index.

checks.result: Independent CLI accepts exact16384-byte policy and rejects16385 bytes. Bare CR and supported ASCII whitespace accepted; embedded NUL in format/name, double root prefix, inline trailing comments and non-ASCII word separator reject as config errors without output. External contract through another module declaration of same linker symbol works.

Main gate inspected after image::finish/link validation and before input::save.

checks.result: Reviewed new4 tests plus unchanged3 integration tests and frozen7-pass log: three target generations, recursive and mixed effects, defer/continue/break expansion, unused and unreachable calls, malformed/duplicate/alias contracts,300-call ordering, Core typing/link failures, missing capture, nonfunction CALL and65537-edge rejection. remaining_boundaries: Verified is the documented direct-call may-block property under declared external contracts; it does not prove termination, real-time, IRQ, concurrency or external implementation truthfulness.
Graph oracle isolates analyzer API using stable CALL records; ordinary source/IR validity remains compiler/backend responsibility and is separately retained in CLI integration.
Old B3 migration, final complete source-clean regressions, actual self-policy run, fixed point and final resource accounting remain N5; N4 does not claim those completed.
